title: Staking & Airdrop Income Tax Impact Modeler
description: Given crypto receipt events, a filing status, and a business election, returns gross ordinary income, self-employment tax if applicable, incremental federal tax, NIIT, state tax, an effective rate, and the deferred gain sitting in the basis created, with an optional disposition model.
data_vintage: 2026 (Rev. Proc. 2025-32; Rev. Rul. 2023-14 staking; Rev. Rul. 2019-24 airdrops)
